title: Premier Upgrade Charge and Unused-Term Credit — Membership Billing Computation (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — the charge collected when a Tailwise Plus Annual member moves up to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual.**

**Charge.** The upgrade charge is $119.00, the membership fee of Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, less the unused-term credit, the figure left never going below zero. The new Premier term starts on the change date with the Tailwise Plus Premier Annual perk credit.

**Unused-term credit.** The latest membership fee charged times the unused days of the current term — from the change date through the term end date, both days counted — divided by the days of the current term — from the term start date through the term end date, both days counted — prorated by calendar day and never below zero.

**Order of working.** Amounts applied to the $119.00 fee are applied in a fixed order: the unused-term credit comes off first; a percentage rate then applies once to that reduced charge; flat dollar amounts are then subtracted from the result.

**Floor and rounding.** The upgrade charge is never below zero and is rounded to the nearest cent as the last step.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** Current term 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2026 (365 days, both counted); latest fee charged $59.00; change date 2 July 2026.

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Unused days, 2 July through 31 December, both counted | 183 |
| Unused-term credit: 59.00 times 183 divided by 365 | $29.5808 |
| Upgrade charge: 119.00 less 29.5808 | $89.4192 |
| Rounded to the cent | $89.42 |
